notes.title: Blindfolded Cube Samurai: RUN! Livestream
notes.content:
Hello Runners!

We at Red Meat Games are going to be livestreaming ourselves playing Cube Samurai: RUN! this Wednesday, August 10th at 2 pm EST. There's a twist this time! Come and watch us play the game while blindfolded and only having audio cues to support players.

You can also join in on the fun and take control of the game by sending us messages in the chat. It's going to be fun, messy and cubie! 

The stream can be found at  Red Meat Plays.

Hope to see you then! (Or not see you...)

Red Meat Games
